title: Python cut detector for page selection, bounded automatic recovery, page-extraction cache with trace page/hash (design 43.3-43.5, REQ-0045)
acceptance_criteria: REQ-0051 AC3 cache with page/hash trace
REQ-0051 AC4 small real slice compared with bridge and independent reads

design.summary: cut last question dropped and extracted whole by a window call seeing pages N and N+1 (up to 3), deterministic cut test from native text, failed window keeps fragment + continues bridge, shared reply cache, extra image only on cut boundaries

implementation.summary: cut detector (pdf adapter), cut test on reply, window extraction, bounded recovery, rule 11, page cache + trace, --no-recover/--no-window/--cache, dry-run line, keyed mock, gold oracle with windows

unit_test.result: 1072 run, only the known failures (identical names to baseline); design tests 1-15 mapped; gold oracle 25 questions 0 orphans; mutations killed after 10 added tests; mock only, no paid run

security.result: no blocking finding (verify.md); cache dir paths hash-named, no traversal

verification.command: python3 -I -m unittest discover -s tests/unit; gold oracle (25 questions, 0 orphans); QA mutations
verification.result: REQ-0051 AC1-AC4 verified by unit + gold oracle with mock replies; cut detector, window extraction, bounded recovery, cost cap before every call, cache key and trace, flags verified; verifier D1 (cache hits unvalidated) fixed in fix round 1; D2 EST_CALL_USD kept at 0.08 (conservative, decision in design); failures identical to baseline 083d0e4; paid real DGNL subset check is REQ-0064, awaiting user go (question Q-1793622303)

user_notes.note: REQ-0055/TASK-052 queued: human review packs per subject and question
